summary.counting_unit: One successfully parsed workout FIT file; multiple sessions in a file count once and are flagged.
summary.validity: Complete parse with strict CRC and parser error checking. Failed-file partial data excluded from all coverage.
summary.value_policy: Non-null finite nonempty decoded values; zero/False are valid; arrays need at least one valid member.
summary.date_policy: UTC session.start_time, then record.timestamp, then activity end time, then file creation time. Source recorded per file.
summary.inventory_policy: All decoded data-message fields including unknown/developer/expanded fields; unused definition declarations are not data coverage.
summary.metric_policy: Case-insensitive field-name patterns, excluding metadata declarations. Matched fields are listed for review. No metrics inferred from speed/cadence.
